_source: IICE Incubation Policy for external and partner-university ventures
name: Virtual incubation
forWhom: Outstation startups, alumni ventures, and partner-university R&D spin-offs collaborating with an IISER Bhopal faculty mentor.
includes: Structured one-on-one technical and scientific mentoring by IISER Bhopal faculty
On-demand booking of Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) analytical instruments and conference rooms
IP filing, patent prior-art search, and technology-transfer advisory through the IICE IP Cell
Participation in Industry–Academia Conclaves, investor demo days, and Ministry of MSME / BIRAC outreach cohorts
